system.description:
The mage gathers and ignites ambient energy into controllable fire, kindling a flame, hurling a bolt of heat, or flashing an object alight. Forces 2 lets the caster perceive and steer existing energy; rank 3 creates and projects it outright. Coincidental casting looks for a spark, a pilot light, or a plausible ignition source.

Dice Pool: Intelligence + Science (+1 die as a rote)

Adapted to M5 from M20 Forces 3; mechanics paraphrased.
